title: IndepAssoc 0.5.0
text: Initial public release. Implements five confounding-adjustment methods (regression, matching, stratification, IPTW, AIPW) testing whether exposure independently associated outcome adjusting measured confounders, generalizing shared analysis pipeline two peer-reviewed cardiac-surgery studies (see README).
